mappings.reason: ADRs 0001/0013/0014/0021/0095/0104: executable typed threaded loading stages isolated resource graphs, genuinely parallel external dependency hooks, monotonic progress, duplicate/concurrent consumers, cooperative cancellation, captured errors, compatible cache identities, deep modes, aliases/root cycles, shared-parent leases and exact ownership cleanup. Publication and replacement callbacks run on the scene owner via deferred completion/status/get; without a tree the consuming caller publishes. Get waits and retires one matching request. Tests exercise two blocked dependencies simultaneously, no partial cache, cancellation, external-cycle rollback, owner shutdown, older worker consumption and zero-byte warmed status polling. Separate-process authored PackedScene gallery renders 30 frames while image I/O is blocked, then instantiates on owner and verifies red/blue pixels on Linux Wayland GPU and compatibility. Native/foreign/AOT/Web bootstrap and human acceptance remain separate gates.
